item.title: 2026-09-25 Parenting: Co-Parenting Advice: Handling a Badmouthing Ex
item.description: - Emotional swings in teens are common during parental separation and are not automatically a sign of manipulation. - Parents are advised to avoid criticizing an ex in front of their child, even if they suspect the same isn't happening in return. - Putting kids in the middle by asking them to report on the other parent can increase stress and strain trust. - Consistency, patience, and direct reassurance from each parent can help teens feel secure during difficult family transitions.
